verses.original: אַרְבַּ֔ע בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ הָיָ֨ה לְדָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֜ה וַֽיְהִי֙ אֶל־ זְכַרְיָ֗ה בְּאַרְבָּעָ֛ה הַתְּשִׁעִ֖י לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ בְּכִסְלֵֽו׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·ba‘ biš·naṯ ham·me·leḵ hā·yāh lə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’el- zə·ḵar·yāh bə·’ar·bā·‘āh hat·tə·ši·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš bə·ḵis·lêw
verses.literal: In the fourth year of King . . . Darius the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month the month of Chislev

verses.original: בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ שַׂר־ אֶ֕צֶר וְרֶ֥גֶם מֶ֖לֶךְ וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֑יו לְחַלּ֖וֹת אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ- ’êl way·yiš·laḥ śar- ’e·ṣer wə·re·ḡem me·leḵ wa·’ă·nā·šāw lə·ḥal·lō·wṯ ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: vvv Now the people of Bethel had sent vvv Sharezer vvv and Regem-melech along with their men to plead - before the LORD

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר אֶל־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְאֶל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר הַֽאֶבְכֶּה֙ הִנָּזֵ֕ר הַחֲמִשִׁ֔י בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי זֶ֖ה כַּמֶּ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr ’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ă·šer lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·’el- han·nə·ḇî·’îm lê·mōr ha·’eḇ·keh hin·nā·zêr ha·ḥă·mi·šî ba·ḥō·ḏeš ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî zeh kam·meh šā·nîm
verses.literal: by asking . . . the priests - of the house of the LORD of Hosts as well as the prophets . . . Should I weep and fast in the fifth month as I have done these many years

verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת וַיְהִ֛י אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me saying

verses.original: אֱמֹר֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר כִּֽי־ צַמְתֶּ֨ם וְסָפ֜וֹד בַּחֲמִישִׁ֣י וּבַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְזֶה֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה אָֽנִי׃ הֲצ֥וֹם צַמְתֻּ֖נִי
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’el- kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm lê·mōr kî- ṣam·tem wə·sā·p̄ō·wḏ ba·ḥă·mî·šî ū·ḇaš·šə·ḇî·‘î wə·zeh šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh ’ā·nî hă·ṣō·wm ṣam·tu·nî
verses.literal: Ask . . . all the people of the land . . . and the priests . . . When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years {was it really} for Me that you fasted . . .

verses.original: וְכִ֥י תֹאכְל֖וּ וְכִ֣י תִשְׁתּ֑וּ הֲל֤וֹא אַתֶּם֙ הָאֹ֣כְלִ֔ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם הַשֹּׁתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ṯō·ḵə·lū wə·ḵî ṯiš·tū hă·lō·w ’at·tem hā·’ō·ḵə·lîm wə·’at·tem haš·šō·ṯîm
verses.literal: And when you were eating . . . and drinking were you not [doing so] . . . . . . simply for yourselves

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ קָרָ֤א בְּיַד֙ הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֔ים הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑יהָ וְעָרֶ֖יהָ בִּהְי֤וֹת יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת וּשְׁלֵוָ֔ה וְהַנֶּ֥גֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה יֹשֵֽׁב׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer Yah·weh qā·rā bə·yaḏ hā·ri·šō·nîm han·nə·ḇî·’îm yə·rū·šā·lim sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯe·hā wə·‘ā·re·hā bih·yō·wṯ yō·še·ḇeṯ ū·šə·lê·wāh wə·han·ne·ḡeḇ wə·haš·šə·p̄ê·lāh yō·šêḇ
verses.literal: Are these not - the words that the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were populous and prosperous and the Negev and the foothills were inhabited

verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי֙ אֶל־ זְכַרְיָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Zechariah saying

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר אָמַ֛ר שְׁפֹ֔טוּ אֱמֶת֙ מִשְׁפַּ֤ט עֲשׂ֖וּ וְחֶ֣סֶד וְרַֽחֲמִ֔ים אֶת־ אִ֥ישׁ אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lê·mōr ’ā·mar šə·p̄ō·ṭū ’ĕ·meṯ miš·paṭ ‘ă·śū wə·ḥe·seḏ wə·ra·ḥă·mîm ’eṯ- ’îš ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts . . . says Administer true justice Show loving devotion and compassion to one another

verses.original: אַֽל־ תַּעֲשֹׁ֑קוּ וְאַלְמָנָ֧ה וְיָת֛וֹם גֵּ֥ר וְעָנִ֖י אַֽל־ תַּחְשְׁב֖וּ וְרָעַת֙ בִּלְבַבְכֶֽם׃ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔יו
verses.transliteration: ’al- ta·‘ă·šō·qū wə·’al·mā·nāh wə·yā·ṯō·wm gêr wə·‘ā·nî ’al- taḥ·šə·ḇū wə·rā·‘aṯ bil·ḇaḇ·ḵem ’îš ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless the foreigner or the poor And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another

verses.original: וַיְמָאֲנ֣וּ לְהַקְשִׁ֔יב וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ סֹרָ֑רֶת כָתֵ֖ף הִכְבִּ֥ידוּ וְאָזְנֵיהֶ֖ם מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·mā·’ă·nū lə·haq·šîḇ way·yit·tə·nū sō·rā·reṯ ḵā·ṯêp̄ hiḵ·bî·ḏū wə·’ā·zə·nê·hem miš·šə·mō·w·a‘
verses.literal: But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder they stopped up their ears from hearing

verses.original: שָׂ֣מוּ וְלִבָּ֞ם שָׁמִ֗יר מִ֠שְּׁמוֹעַ אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֤ה וְאֶת־ הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שָׁלַ֜ח בְּרוּח֔וֹ בְּיַ֖ד הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֑ים הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים גָּד֔וֹל קֶ֣צֶף וַֽיְהִי֙ מֵאֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: śā·mū wə·lib·bām šā·mîr miš·šə·mō·w·a‘ ’eṯ- hat·tō·w·rāh wə·’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šā·laḥ bə·rū·ḥōw bə·yaḏ hā·ri·šō·nîm han·nə·ḇî·’îm gā·ḏō·wl qe·ṣep̄ way·hî mê·’êṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: They made their hearts [like] flint and would not listen to - the law or to the words that the LORD of Hosts had sent by His Spirit through the earlier prophets Therefore great anger came from the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י כַאֲשֶׁר־ קָרָ֖א וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ כֵּ֤ן יִקְרְאוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֔ע אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵa·’ă·šer- qā·rā wə·lō šā·mê·‘ū kên yiq·rə·’ū wə·lō ’eš·mā‘ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: And just as I had called and they would not listen so when they called I would not listen says the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: וְאֵ֣סָעֲרֵ֗ם עַ֤ל כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יְדָע֔וּם וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נָשַׁ֣מָּה אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם מֵֽעֹבֵ֖ר וּמִשָּׁ֑ב וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ חֶמְדָּ֖ה אֶֽרֶץ־ לְשַׁמָּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·sā·‘ă·rêm ‘al kāl- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer lō- yə·ḏā·‘ūm wə·hā·’ā·reṣ nā·šam·māh ’a·ḥă·rê·hem mê·‘ō·ḇêr ū·miš·šāḇ way·yā·śî·mū ḥem·dāh ’e·reṣ- lə·šam·māh
verses.literal: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations that they had not known and the land was left desolate behind them so that no one could come or go Thus they turned the pleasant land into a desolation
